scope: affine tensor-product N1curl, uniform degree p, periodic x/y, open z, no hanging cells
explanation: Count tangential x/y components with the two open z planes and normal z components with periodic x/y. Static condensation removes cell-interior unknowns but does not change the independent FE approximation dimension.
limitations: Validate against the actual mesh, constraint and degree-plan audits before reporting measured DoFs. No memory, time or accuracy conclusion follows from these counts. The control is excluded from adaptive marking and ranking.
